ui.timeline.label: Track position
ui.splash.tip2: Your library stays on your hub — no mandatory cloud.
ui.splash.tip3: Space pauses and resumes, the arrow keys skip 15 seconds.
ui.splash.tip4: Press S to turn shuffle on or off.
ui.splash.tip5: Very large libraries take a few more seconds — that's normal.
ui.splash.tip6: Studio › Listen has synced lyrics and the visualizer.
ui.splash.tip7: Exclude a track from shuffle without removing it from the library.
ui.splash.tip8: Tag up to three moods per track and filter by them in the Library.
ui.splash.tip9: Plectr turns any track into a rhythm game.
ui.splash.tip10: Favourites, playlists and plays follow your account on every device.
